Advisors’ Opinion: [By Paul Ausick]
Xerox Corp. (NYSE: XRX ) dropped about 23% on Tuesday to post a new 52-week low of $6.46 after closing at $8.73 on Friday. The dip was the result of the company’s completed separation into two firms this morning. After the early drop shares had gained around 17% by late afternoon, probably on the strength of a cash payment of $1.8 billion. [By ]
A New York Judge late Friday issued an order temporarily blocking Xerox Corp.’s ( XRX ) plan to merge with Fujifilm. At the same time, the judge gave the document technology company’s third-largest shareholder permission to move ahead with a change-of-control proxy contest to take over Xerox’s board. AVEO Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVEO ) shares shot up 69 percent to $1.23 after the company reported positive CHMP opinion for tivozanib for the treatment of advanced renal cell carcinoma. [By Money Morning News Team]
